migration_batches.rationale: The 105 authoritative HCC-TACE-Seg Pathology source rows and values are byte-identical. A package-version-triggered IDC reload exposed legacy diagnosis-derived fact IDs after the stored concept had already been reviewed as grade. This one-time migration replaces only those 105 legacy IDs with canonical grade-derived IDs; raw rows, raw values, resolved semantics, and QC disposition remain unchanged.
